Postgres WAL archives are retained for 14 days, as part of the nightly base backup + continuous WAL archiving setup for point-in-time recovery.

Sources: tidewater/memory/decisions.md (ADR-007), tidewater/plans/2026-02-20-backup-pitr.md

Paylane retries a webhook delivery every 5 minutes for up to 24 hours until it receives a 2xx response.

Sources: tidewater/skills/investigate-double-charge.md

BUG-017 ("Same admission accepted at two gates within two seconds," severity high) is **fixed in version 1.9.2** — a race between two gates validating the same QR token, resolved via single-use entry tokens in Gatekeeper (ADR-011).

Sources: tidewater/docs/bugs.md, tidewater/plans/2026-04-16-gatekeeper-single-use.md

The plan "Idempotent Paylane webhooks" (tidewater/plans/2026-03-02-webhook-idempotency.md) fixed the bug behind INC-2, adding webhook idempotency to Paylane to prevent duplicate charges.

Sources: tidewater/docs/incidents/2026-02-27-inc-2-duplicate-charges.md, tidewater/plans/2026-03-02-webhook-idempotency.md

The atlas `sales_ingest` job reads from tidewater's read replica `pg-replica`, which runs on host `kelp-4`, port 5434.

Sources: atlas/memory/architecture.md, tidewater/memory/environments.md

The Paylane sandbox key was most recently rotated on **2026-05-20** (an earlier rotation happened on 2026-02-19; the prod secret key was rotated separately on 2026-04-15).

Sources: tidewater/log.md, tidewater/skills/rotate-paylane-keys.md

Held seats aren't released immediately on abandonment; a `tide-worker` scans holds every 30 seconds and lapses unpaid ones after ten minutes, returning the seats to inventory and invalidating the event page cache (a late Paylane confirmation on an already-lapsed hold triggers an automatic refund, per a fix for BUG-014).

Sources: tidewater/plans/2026-04-01-hold-release-worker.md, tidewater/docs/bugs.md

Account-recovery (forgotten password) emails are sent asynchronously by `tide-worker`, which dispatches them through the MailRiver transactional email service using the template `reset-v3`.

Sources: tidewater/memory/architecture.md

Teatro Verdi's administration office requires a printed invoice ("fattura cartacea") for every settlement, mailed to them.

Sources: tidewater/docs/partners/teatro-verdi.md

No, there's no Kubernetes deployment skill in the vault — the closest related skills are "Deploy to staging" and "Scale the worker pool," neither of which mention Kubernetes.

Sources: tidewater/skills/deploy-to-staging.md, tidewater/skills/scale-worker-pool.md
